notes.title: Easter Update!
notes.content:
🐤 The Slime Sprint Easter update has just been released! This includes 10 new levels and 2 new skins to play with. That also means there are 10 more diamond medals to grind for! The regular gems that are collected have been switch out with Easter eggs, new homing enemies have been added and a new box map style has been included. Be sure to update and play to check out all the new features!🐇
🐣
Slime Sprint is on sale from 10:00 PT on Saturday 3rd April for 7 days so if you enjoy the game be sure to give it a share over this period!🐥
